explanation: The theorem is the universal property of the fundamental group of a union of two open path-connected sets with path-connected intersection (the groups-level van Kampen theorem). I grepped Mathlib for "van Kampen" and for FundamentalGroup. The only "van Kampen" hits are the categorical notion in CategoryTheory/Limits/VanKampen.lean and related files, which is unrelated to this statement. The FundamentalGroup hits are in AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid and a few topology files, and none of them has a van Kampen or open-cover pushout statement. I found no matching declaration.
